name: Phishing / credential solicitation
description: Credentials requested through a deceptive message.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Relationship-based scam
description: Trust from an online relationship used to request money.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Investment offer scam
description: A purported investment uses deceptive returns or withdrawal demands.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Account or identity takeover
description: Someone may control an account or misuse identity details.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Buying or selling scam
description: A deceptive transaction involving a product or service.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Threat or authority impersonation
description: A threat or false authority claim pressures a payment.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Job or task scam
description: An employment or task offer requires deceptive payments.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Unexpected prize or rebate
description: An unexpected windfall requires fees or information.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Invoice / business email compromise
description: An invoice directs payment to substituted recipient details.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Recovery-fee scam
description: Someone promises to recover an earlier loss for a fee.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Donation impersonation
description: A supposed charity or collection may be deceptive.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Betting or gambling scam
description: A betting offer or platform uses deceptive terms or payments.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Unrecognised financial transaction
description: A transaction is not recognised; authorisation remains to be clarified.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Remote-access exposure
description: A stranger may control the device used for financial accounts.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Payment issue without established fraud
description: Delay or failure alone does not establish a scam.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.

name: Insufficient information / mixed situation
description: Facts are missing or do not support one reliable category.
classification_note: Provisional, non-exclusive product label; not a legal finding.
